title: WebSocket opening handshake: parse the upgrade, check the origin, answer 101
spec: Implement accept_key, head_len, parse_upgrade and upgrade_response as the doc comments say, by hand over bytes and &str (no HTTP or WebSocket library: the handshake is small and the rules are the contract). accept_key uses the sha1 and base64 crates, which are existing workspace dependencies now added to this crate. Delete the `#[allow(clippy::todo)]` on the stubs. No other new dependencies.
